expected_new_schema_objects.registrations_erase_on_deactivation:
CREATE TRIGGER registrations_erase_on_deactivation
AFTER UPDATE OF disabled, invalid ON registrations
WHEN NEW.disabled = 1 OR NEW.invalid = 1
BEGIN
	DELETE FROM registrations WHERE id = NEW.id;
END
expected_new_schema_objects.idx_registrations_last_success:
CREATE INDEX idx_registrations_last_success ON registrations (last_success_at)
	WHERE last_success_at IS NOT NULL
expected_new_schema_objects.idx_registrations_last_error:
CREATE INDEX idx_registrations_last_error ON registrations (updated_at)
	WHERE last_error_code IS NOT NULL

migration_boundary.scope_note: The numbered migration is the sole permitted immediate D1 mutation, including its own migration bookkeeping. Standalone application DML and manual DDL are outside this scope. The new cron separately owns its normal expired-diagnostics purge.

preflight_observation.expected_counts_at_dispatch: Refresh observations; live traffic can change the counts. The deletion predicate is the authorization boundary.

rollback.schema: Retain 0013, the erasure trigger, its indexes and the live post-erasure D1 database.
rollback.cron: If the candidate cron was enabled, remove it under protection before routing traffic to the old Worker. Confirm an empty effective schedule and quiescence of pending or running invocations, allowing for propagation. Verify zero triggers again after traffic switch.
rollback.retention: The old Worker has no scheduled handler. Use a forward fix unless old-code schema/erasure compatibility and a separately reviewed expiry-preserving maintenance path have both been proved. Do not introduce an unreviewed purge or widen retention.
rollback.partial_failure: Stop on partial or unknown migration or deployment results. Read back actual schema, ledger, Worker and cron. If 0013 has committed, preserve it and use the same recovery policy.
rollback.in_flight_delivery: For a Worker rollback, require the same proof for relevant existing sends and retries. Keep push admission closed until the old Worker is verified against the retained post-erasure database.
rollback.registration_authority: Prove revoked or stale authorization cannot create a fresh registration after the switch. The old Worker upsert can create an active row, and the erasure trigger only runs on updates that disable or invalidate a row.

requires: Protected Core approval and exact production migration and deployment receipts.
Independent Worker, D1, cron and closed-route readback.
First scheduled purge evidence and aggregate counts without registration data.

execution.required_guard: The protected production executor must verify the manifest-pinned target, migration file digest and exact pending set immediately before mutation, then apply only 0013 and verify the ledger before deploying. A check performed outside the execution lane is insufficient. Require a one-to-one match of preflight_pending and pending_sha256, preserve list order, compare the actual pending list without sorting, and verify the exact archived bytes. Existing empty lists without a hash map remain valid.
execution.preflight: Refresh live Worker deployment/version, D1 identity, migration ledger, schema and retention; check unchanged bindings, routes, five Durable Object identities and absence of cron. Serialize all production writes that could change migration or trigger state; stop on drift.
execution.deployment: Apply only 0013 using the protected D1 migration mechanism. Require the exact post-apply D1 ledger before deploying the pinned bundle with one hourly cron. Independently verify the erasure result, trigger, indexes, final live Worker SHA and effective trigger list before declaring the release delivered.
execution.smoke: Independently verify production health SHA and version, the applied migration, the erasure trigger and indexes, zero inactive registrations at the cutover, unchanged binding and route identities, five unchanged Durable Object identities, and the effective cron. Observe the first scheduled diagnostic purge using aggregate counts and provider evidence. Verify closed public VibeCast and Watch Moment routes. Keep native push acceptance separate.

cutover.scope: Only this artifact and migration 0013 on api.djconnect.dev while the service is in pre-release use. The Cloudflare target remains production.
cutover.residual_risk: The old Worker can send or retry with a previously loaded APNs target during the switch or after 0013 deletes its registration. It can also admit requests before the new version takes over. Termination of old invocations has not been established.
cutover.execution: Keep the rollout serialized. Refresh the production baseline immediately before dispatch and stop on drift. Apply only the verified 0013 migration and switch directly to the pinned Worker in the same protected workflow run. Verify the actual Worker, ledger, trigger and cron independently.
cutover.future_cutovers: This acceptance applies only to this manifest. It provides no drain evidence or authority for future cutovers, rollback, or restoration of erased registrations.

next_authorized_action: Complete protected Core review and merge, refresh the production preflight, then dispatch the exact artifact and verify the cutover independently.

recovery.preservation: Do not restore production D1 in place, rebind the Worker to a historical copy, or import historical registration rows. A historical recovery copy, if separately approved, remains isolated from production routes, Worker bindings, cron and APNs credentials. A pre-erasure snapshot can contain rows then marked active, so re-running 0013 alone cannot establish eligibility.
stop_conditions: Uncertain deletion state, schema, effective cron, active Worker or namespace identity.
No verified method to preserve all post-bookmark erasures and revocations during recovery.

cron_boundary.purpose: Purge expired relay and push delivery diagnostics using the candidate policy.
